summary_en: 930,000 ordinary shares to be cancelled effective 2026-08-31. Post-cancellation issued shares outstanding (ex-treasury): 29,227,184. Treasury thereafter 4.97% of issued. Cancellation authorised by board 2026-08-13 under Companies Act art. 178, reflecting policy to hold treasury at ~5% of issued stock.
title_en: Notice regarding cancellation of treasury shares
translation_en_brief: MEDLEY, INC. resolved by board on 2026-08-13 under Companies Act article 178 to cancel 930,000 ordinary shares held in treasury, effective 2026-08-31. Pre-cancellation issued stock (including treasury) was 32,738,600 shares; post-cancellation will be 31,808,600. Treasury shares before cancellation numbered 2,511,416 (7.67% of pre-cancellation issued); after cancellation will number 1,581,416, representing 4.97% of post-cancellation issued stock. The board simultaneously adopted a policy to hold treasury shares at approximately 5% of issued stock, with amounts exceeding that threshold to be cancelled as a matter of principle. This cancellation implements that policy.
